concerns.text: T005 updates connectivity.schema.yaml and data-model.md but NOT timeseries.schema.yaml, whose `data` field is described as "BOLD signal values after confound regression" — directly contradicting FR-004/T003's raw pre-regression time-series. T003 says Parquet files are validated 'via a JSON side-record' against this schema, so the implementer hits a spec-contract contradiction at execution time. Add timeseries.schema.yaml's `data` description fix to T005's edit list.

No task produces `code/requirements.txt` (or pyproject.toml) with version-pinned dependencies, despite the Constitution's Reproducibility Requirements mandating it and plan.md listing it ('requirements.txt version-locked'). T001 imports `openneuro`, `nibabel`, etc. with no task establishing the pinned environment. Add a small setup task (or fold into T001) with the deliverable `code/requirements.txt` verified by a fresh-venv install.

T005's verification is 'contracts and data model updated and internally consistent' — no concrete check. Make it verifiable, e.g. 'run jsonschema validation of a sample connectivity record against the updated connectivity.schema.yaml and confirm result_schema.schema.yaml is the only result contract present in contracts/'.
